description: Walmart.com products from searches, category links or product links: price, was-price, rating, review count, seller, stock and sponsored flag. With details on: brand, model, UPC, specifications, description and seller rating. Filter by price, rating and stock; sort like the site. Useful for price checks, assortment research and price/stock monitoring. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/walmart-products on your Apify account (about $0.003 per product, plus about $0.0022 per product with full details; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

in_stock_only.description: Drop products shown as out of stock.

include_details.description: Open each product page for brand, UPC, specs and description (extra cost per product).

links.description: Walmart search, category or product links, or product item ids.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

max_price.description: Highest price to keep, in USD.

min_price.description: Lowest price to keep, in USD.

min_rating.description: Lowest star rating to keep, e.g. 4.

queries.description: Search words as typed on Walmart.com, e.g. ["air fryer"].

name: get_walmart_products

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get products from Walmart
